name: Hero's journey
description: Journey out of the familiar world through testing, transformation and return.

acts.title: Departure
acts.description: The main character leaves his familiar order.

beats.title: Familiar world
beats.description: Everyday life, lack and potential of the main character become visible.
guidingQuestions: What binds them to this world?

beats.title: Call to adventure
beats.description: A task or threat demands change.
guidingQuestions: What is at stake in inaction?

beats.title: refusal
beats.description: Fear, duty or doubt inhibit departure.

beats.title: Meeting the mentor
beats.description: Help, knowledge or a tool pave the way.
guidingQuestions: What does the character have to do himself?

beats.title: Crossing the threshold
beats.description: The main character enters the unknown world of conflict.
guidingQuestions: Why is it difficult to return now?

acts.title: Trials and change
acts.description: Relationships, dangers and insights shape the main character.

beats.title: Trials, allies and enemies
beats.description: The rules of the new world are learned through conflict.

beats.title: Approaching the deepest cave
beats.description: The character prepares for the core conflict.

beats.title: Crucial test
beats.description: An existential crisis requires change or sacrifice.

beats.title: Reward
beats.description: After the test, knowledge, power or reconciliation is gained.
guidingQuestions: What danger is not yet over?

acts.title: return
acts.description: The conversion must be confirmed in a final inspection.

beats.title: way back
beats.description: Consequences and enemies force the figure to return.
guidingQuestions: Why does she have to return?

beats.title: resurrection
beats.description: The final test shows the transformation that has taken place.
guidingQuestions: What old weakness will be overcome?
Who does the decision serve other than herself?

beats.title: Return with the elixir
beats.description: The knowledge gained changes the initial world.
guidingQuestions: What does the character bring back?
